in_sanskrit.name: भजन
in_sanskrit.meaning: To sing, to adore, to praise, to recite
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The act of singing devotional songs, reciting religious texts, or expressing deep feelings of love and devotion.

in_hindi.name: भजन
in_hindi.long_meaning: Someone who engages in Bhajan (the act of singing devotional songs or expressing deep feelings of love and devotion)

in_tamil.name: பஜன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: A devotional song, a person who sings such songs, or the act of expressing deep feelings of love and devotion.

in_telugu.name: భజన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: A devotee, someone who is devoted to a deity, or a devotional song.

in_marathi.name: Bhajan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhajan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bhaj’ meaning ‘to adore, to love, or to serve’. This name is given to a child who is believed to have a deep connection with God and is destined to spread love and devotion through his actions.
